description: Provincia di Biella - fermate autobus is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provincia.biella.it. The data, the result of an extraction from the regional one, identifies all the stops of the public road taxi network that concern the management of the service by the Province of Biella, and includes the name and the regional alphanumeric code. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Province of Biella — bus stops" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trasporto, autobus, RNDT, pubblico, INSPIRE, rete. The listing shows 2013-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
